title: Healthy Suji Bread
steps: To a bowl add 1½ cups suji, 1 tbsp caster sugar, 1 tsp instant yeast, ¼ tsp salt, Mix well.
Then add ½ cup water, 3 tbsp milk, 2 tbsp oil, Mix everything well and let it rest for 10 minutes.
Transfer the dough onto a greased surface and knead well for 15 minutes.
Cover and let the dough proof for 1 hour, or until it doubles in size.
Once doubled, punch it down, roll it out and shape it into a log. Make sure to pinch and seal the dough after every roll.
Transfer it into a greased loaf pan, cover and let it rise again. This took me about 2–3 hours.
Brush the top with milk, sprinkle with seeds of your choice and bake in a preheated oven at 180°C for 30 minutes, or until golden brown. (You can also use a pressure cooker like the original recipe.)
Let it cool, slice it up and your homemade Suji Bread is ready!
assumptions: The creator also gives 11 g fibre for the loaf.

flags.note: The creator's numbers are "whole loaf", and the caption doesn't say how many portions that is.
No protein source reaches 35 % of the protein (CONTEXT §4), so it has no main protein.
